page.layout: One page of text, with a printed page number at the top left; a short running heading area is absent. The main text is a dedication in italic type, with the date line; below it a faint show-through of mirrored text from the reverse side, which is not transcribed. A word "Index" stands at the right in the lower half, set as a heading-like line.

main_text.head: Illustres Ordines, Domini Amplissimi, vos gratia caelesti sua seruet incolumnes, consilijs praesit, actionibus benedicat, & regionis totius vestra Ecclesijs veritatem cum sanctimonia, Reipub. felicitatem sub vestro praesidio largiatur quàm diutissimè. Lugduno Bat. Kal. Aprilibus clɔ. Iɔ. xcv.

page.notes: The dedication is set in italic type with long s printed as s. The lower part of the page carries only faint show-through from the other side, and the column of mirrored text is not transcribed. The line "Index" appears at the right of the lower half. The date line is printed with reversed-C numerals, rendered here as clɔ. Iɔ. (MDXCV). The first line of the dedication is rendered as a heading. Some letters in the italic lines are uncertain, notably in "Ordines" and "sanctimonia", but no [?] was needed because the printed forms are clear enough.
